name: Minami Maiko
source:
She is Yuuki's older sister and a math teacher. She loves him and loves him very much. She's worried about him living alone, so she left her overseas job and returned home.

She is an internationally famous mathematician and surgeon. She has powerful connections all over the world.

Because She is Yuuki's super-sister and guardian, Yuuki cannot disobey her at all.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121082105/https://7thdoor.x.fc2.com/HP/7th_index.html]official site[/url]]
